ul.li: Ensure safe and coordinated discharge process considering patient's history of aortic valve replacement and multiple comorbidities, with clear instructions for follow-up, medication management, and support at home.
Reduce dyspnea, fatigue, and other symptoms associated with aortic valve regurgitation to improve quality of life.
Maintain systolic and diastolic blood pressure within target range to reduce cardiac workload.
Avoid fluid overload to prevent exacerbation of heart failure symptoms.
Monitor kidney function to avoid worsening renal impairment due to cardiac condition or its treatment.
Encourage safe, tolerable physical activity to maintain functional status without exacerbating symptoms.
